Recipe
Ingredients: 
1 cup of Carolina rice
1 7oz can of tuna in oil
1/2 teaspoon of ground pepper
1/2 cup of Parmesan cheese
2 tablespoons of fresh parsley
1/3 cup of unseasoned bread crumbs
1 egg
Directions: 
Cook the rice, season it with salt to taste, and let it cool. In a medium bowl, combine the tuna, rice, egg, salt, pepper, bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, and chopped parsley. Heat the vegetable oil. 
In a shallow Pyrex tray, mix the breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese. Roll the rice-tuna balls, coat them in the breadcrumb mixture, and fry until golden brown.

Orange Milk Cake Tartlets
Ingredients:
2 1/2 cups of milk
1 1/4 cups of sugar 
1 1/4 cups of all purpose flour 
1/2 cup of orange juice 
2 tbs of melted butter (unsalted)
1/2 tsp of vanilla extract 
2 large eggs
1 tbs of room temperature butter to grease tin cupcake pan
Powdered sugar
Yields 14 to 16 queijadas 
Directions:
Preheat oven 350F 
1. Warm milk
2. Grease cupcake pan
3. In a bowl mix sugar and eggs and mix
4. Add orange juice, orange zest, butter and vanilla extract and mix 
5. Add flour gradually and mix
6. Add warm milk and mix well
7. Pour into greased cupcake pan 
Bake for 25 to 30 mins 
Cool down and dust with powdered sugar 
Enjoy 😊
